title: Aarogya Ka Raj
style: clean medical 3D illustration of a translucent human body in the yoga pose, the spine and the working muscles softly glowing, dark blue background, whole body visible, scientific, highly detailed, vertical 9:16
img_suffix: Show the whole body, not a close-up of a face. Correct anatomy. No text, no watermark, no logos.

scenes.image: A translucent body stands in Tadasana (mountain pose), feet together, hands by sides. No specific muscles glowing yet.
scenes.speaker: sir
scenes.line: Namaste! Aaj hum Trikonasana seekhenge, ek adbhut aasan.
scenes.say: नमस्ते! आज हम त्रिकोणासन सीखेंगे, एक अद्भुत आसन।

scenes.image: A translucent body standing, focus on the general outline.
scenes.speaker: sir
scenes.line: Trikonasana, yaani Tribhuj Aasan, sharir ko kholta hai.
scenes.say: त्रिकोणासन, यानि त्रिभुज आसन, शरीर को खोलता है।

scenes.image: A translucent body spreading its feet wide, ready for the pose.
scenes.speaker: sir
scenes.line: Apne pairon ko chauda faila kar khade ho jaayen.
scenes.say: अपने पैरों को चौड़ा फैला कर खड़े हो जाएँ।

scenes.image: A translucent body with one foot turned outwards, the other straight.
scenes.speaker: sir
scenes.line: Daahine pair ko bahar ki or moden, baayen ko seedha.
scenes.say: दाहिने पैर को बाहर की ओर मोड़ें, बायें को सीधा।

scenes.image: A translucent body with arms extended to the sides at shoulder height.
scenes.speaker: sir
scenes.line: Apne haathon ko kandhon ki seedh mein uthaayen.
scenes.say: अपने हाथों को कंधों की सीध में उठाएँ।

scenes.image: A translucent body beginning to bend sideways towards the turned-out foot.
scenes.speaker: sir
scenes.line: Saans chhodte hue, daahini or dheere se jhukein.
scenes.say: साँस छोड़ते हुए, दाहिनी ओर धीरे से झुकें।

scenes.image: A clean anatomical picture of a translucent body in the finished Trikonasana pose. The spine (especially lumbar and thoracic regions) and working muscles like obliques, hamstrings, and inner thighs are glowing brightly.
scenes.speaker: sir
scenes.line: Daahina haath pair par aur baaya haath upar uthaayen.
scenes.say: दाहिना हाथ पैर पर और बायाँ हाथ ऊपर उठाएँ।

scenes.image: A translucent body in Trikonasana, focus on the head turning towards the raised hand.
scenes.speaker: sir
scenes.line: Apni najar upar uthe hue haath par rakhein.
scenes.say: अपनी नज़र ऊपर उठे हुए हाथ पर रखें।

scenes.image: A translucent body in Trikonasana, highlighting the straight line from head to back foot.
scenes.speaker: sir
scenes.line: Sharir ko ek seedhi rekha mein rakhne ka prayas karein.
scenes.say: शरीर को एक सीधी रेखा में रखने का प्रयास करें।

scenes.image: A translucent body holding the Trikonasana pose, then slowly returning to standing.
scenes.speaker: sir
scenes.line: Is aasan mein kuch der rukein, phir uth jaayen.
scenes.say: इस आसन में कुछ देर रुकें, फिर उठ जाएँ।

scenes.image: A translucent body setting up for Trikonasana on the other side.
scenes.speaker: sir
scenes.line: Ab yahi prakriya doosri or bhi dohrayein, aaram se.
scenes.say: अब यही प्रक्रिया दूसरी ओर भी दोहराएँ, आराम से।

scenes.image: A translucent body showing the side body being stretched.
scenes.speaker: sir
scenes.line: Trikonasana peeth, kamar aur pairon ko halka khinchav deta hai.
scenes.say: त्रिकोणासन पीठ, कमर और पैरों को हल्का खिंचाव देता है।

scenes.image: A close-up of the glowing back and side torso muscles (obliques, latissimus dorsi) and hamstrings/inner thighs, indicating the stretch.
scenes.speaker: sir
scenes.line: Yeh santulan aur sharir ki lachak badhaane mein madad kar sakta hai.
scenes.say: यह संतुलन और शरीर की लचक बढ़ाने में मदद कर सकता है।

scenes.image: A translucent body demonstrating a slow, controlled movement.
scenes.speaker: sir
scenes.line: Hamesha dheere dheere karein, jaldbazi bilkul na karein.
scenes.say: हमेशा धीरे धीरे करें, जल्दबाज़ी बिलकुल ना करें।

scenes.image: A translucent body looking concerned, indicating discomfort.
scenes.speaker: sir
scenes.line: Agar koi dard ho toh turant ruk jaayen.
scenes.say: अगर कोई दर्द हो तो तुरंत रुक जाएँ।

scenes.image: A translucent body with a subtle 'X' mark on an injured area (generic).
scenes.speaker: sir
scenes.line: Chot ya bimari mein doctor se pooch kar hi karein.
scenes.say: चोट या बीमारी में डॉक्टर से पूछ कर ही करें।

scenes.image: A translucent body with a guiding hand gesture from an implied teacher.
scenes.speaker: sir
scenes.line: Ya kisi prashikshit yoga guru ki dekhrekh mein karein.
scenes.say: या किसी प्रशिक्षित योग गुरु की देखरेख में करें।

scenes.image: A translucent body in a relaxed, friendly pose.
scenes.speaker: sir
scenes.line: Aapko Trikonasana ka abhyaas kaisa laga?
scenes.say: आपको त्रिकोणासन का अभ्यास कैसा लगा?
